questions.stem: Priya, a 26-year-old health administrator, is assigned the task of evaluating health resources in a rural district of Uttar Pradesh. During her initial assessment, she comes across a Community Health Centre (CHC) and wishes to determine the number of people this center should ideally serve. She recalls some of her training but seeks confirmation on the population range that a CHC in a rural setting is intended to cater to. Which of the following is the most accurate population range that a Community Health Centre in a rural area is designed to serve?
